scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && zip -qr -FS dist/Apify-Insights-Plus-0.0.1.zip manifest.json content lib popup icons README.md
scripts.check: for file in content/*.js lib/*.js popup/*.js scripts/*.js; do node --check "$file"; done && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.json'))"
scripts.test: node test/range.test.js && node test/context-cache.test.js && node test/api.test.js && node test/performance.test.js && node test/actor-detail.test.js && node test/profile-sort.test.js && node test/benchmark.test.js && node test/benchmark-source.test.js
